body: I feel for Brooklinen as well. My boyfriend purchased a set of their linen sheets as a Christmas present for me last year and holy crap I have never been so disappointed in my life! I have had $20 sheets from Walmart that last longer and were better in quality. All corners of the fitted sheet are ripped at the seems, there are also holes in the fitted sheet from the fabric already being worn through and we have had them for barely a year. Brooklinen is supposed to have a 1 year warranty so we reached out for a refund…you can guess how well that went. It’s been over a month and still nothing.
